notes.title: Check Out Our New Game, Party Words!
notes.content:
Greetings Programs!

Sam & Kelsie here, back at it again with another casual multiplayer party game, Party Words!
Party Words is a word party game with a bunch of different game modes and a ton of words to keep it fresh! Pass and play with a single device or join multiple devices to unlock new possibilities. Who's the fastest guesser? Who has all the ideas? Whose doodles are the best? Find out with Party Words.

[previewyoutube=u7tw94fGV7s;full][/previewyoutube]

In classic Kelsam fashion, it has a bunch of different game modes :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/595c6097c339db4d020419f40ca5f2a23a5d2ceb.png

Party Words is on sale for the Early Access release this week :) If you decide to check it out, please leave us a review! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992530/Party_Words/

Let's Get This Party Started!
 - Kelsam
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/3a307b3ce22f6e73f45b634cd8988e32c1fdde3b.png
P.S.  It's also available on Google Play so your non-Steam friends can join on their devices. 
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/5ad7fab56fd965a8b8b252ee5916326b4076acc3.png

notes.title: Simple Light Cycles is Now Free!
notes.content:
Greetings Programs!

In celebration of the release of our newest game, Cymatically Muffed, we are now offering Simple Light Cycles for free!

Thanks to everyone who has helped us get this far and supported our projects!

SLC was a game-jam style game that we put together in a weekend after playing a similar game that had laggy controls. We wanted to have a casual game to play with our friends and family that we could all enjoy and have the game be responsive enough to not cause frustration. We had a ton of fun with Simple Light Cycles and we hope you've enjoyed it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/e9fb6f225724274e151ab0a7db98ded66ab83e9b.gif


Our new game had similar goals, we wanted a game we could play together, without our 5th or 6th friends having to trade off controllers. This time around we wanted a story mode that we could play alone or together, and a PvP mode where we could fight it out with bigger groups. Muffed has a much more complex system, but we're happy to report that it's still fun for people of all ages, regardless of skill level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/59d26ad2ba2f98c10af91ee321d6fb2511c665e8.jpg


Since you're here, we're pretty sure you like local multiplayer games, we'd love it if you would check out Muffed. :)

Thanks for playing our games!
 - Kelsam
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/3a307b3ce22f6e73f45b634cd8988e32c1fdde3b.png

End of Line.

notes.title: Cymatically Muffed, a new multiplayer game from Kelsam :)
notes.content:
Greetings Programs!

In case you haven't heard, we have a new multiplayer game called Cymatically Muffed :)

It's in Early Access here on Steam if you want to check it out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/499e60673bcb6ea480090eab9597004863f8f40c.png
Muffed is a fast-paced top-down shooter—⁠with weapons and game modes to spare—for 1-16 players! Co-Op campaign, machine guns, PvP battle games, laser swords, survival mode, great music, level editor, giant headphones that give you powers... is that a drone? Toss in some controllers and let's party! 


Sam and Kelsie made it, you know there's a bunch of game modes and customizations :)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/35adaf60b6cc9a61a11b3e89a7f4d13ba9d2997c.png

We also put in a ton of weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/1d78861f7486900986e7e81c46ebb6603741f3b3.gif

If Muffed is your speed, you should wishlist it! If not, we'll catch you on the grid.

Game On,
 - Kelsam

End of Line.

notes.title: v1.28 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Changes

	Do not allow color change after that player has been in a game. Player can leave and re-join game to change color if needed.
	Improved projectiles controls
	Improved Steam Controller configrequires manual update from user via Steam Controller Configurator


Bug Fixes

	Assassin mode occasional points awarded on crashed bikers
	Gamepads firing projectiles for keyboard players

notes.title: v1.27 Update Notes
notes.content:
New Features

	Added "Dot Obstacles" feature (found in Gameplay Settings menu)
		
			When set to more than 0, this feature will render a set amount of 3x3 "dots" on the game board, in random locations, that players must avoid.
		
	
	Added "Invisible Obstacles" feature (found in Gameplay Settings menu)
		
			When enabled, this feature will make obstacles invisible during gameplay (after the countdown).
		
	
	Added feature to flash player's trail and score when they gain points (can be disabled via Gameplay Settings menu)
